DIAGNOSIS.md.text:
# Recovery diagnosis

Reproduction: the specified Python acceptance command exits with code 1 at
acceptance.py:3 for the first input, None.

Cause and evidence: app/greeting.py returns `Hello, {name}!` without normalizing
the name. The handoff and acceptance assertions require `Welcome, NAME.`, with
`traveler` for None or blank names and surrounding whitespace removed.

Next experiment: update only app/greeting.py to normalize the name and format
the required welcome. Run acceptance.py unchanged, then standard-library
assertions for mixed case, Unicode whitespace, and preserved Unicode characters.
